result.instructions: Tools for Play Systems, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the e-invoices we issued this month for our VAT number."; "Show the payments recorded against invoice 12345."; "What is the web usage of our hosting package this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Play Systems data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run playsystemsapi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run playsystemsapi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run playsystemsapi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. playsystemsapi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: playsystemsapi_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List e-invoices (Greek AADE/myDATA) for an issuer. Give a 15-digit MARK for one invoice, or an issuer VAT number with an optional invoice type and date range. Read-only: GET /invoices.

mark.description: Exact AADE MARK number (15 digits). When set, the other filters are ignored.

issuerVat.description: Issuer VAT number (9 digits). Required when no mark is given.

invoiceType.description: Invoice type code, for example "1.1" or "2.1". Needs issuerVat.

dateFrom.description: Invoices issued on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd). Needs issuerVat.

dateTo.description: Invoices issued on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd). Needs issuerVat.

next.description: Cursor from meta.nextCursor of the previous page. Pass it unmodified.

tools.name: playsystemsapi_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one e-invoice with its lines, totals and status. Read-only: GET /invoices/{invoiceId}.

invoiceId.description: Invoice id, as returned by playsystemsapi_list_invoices.

tools.name: playsystemsapi_list_invoice_payments
tools.title: List invoice payments
tools.description: List the payments recorded against one e-invoice. Read-only: GET /invoices/{invoiceId}/payments.

invoiceId.description: Invoice id, as returned by playsystemsapi_list_invoices.

tools.name: playsystemsapi_get_package
tools.title: Get hosting package
tools.description: Get one hosting package on Play Cloud Services: plan, status and limits. Read-only: GET /cloud/package/{packageId}.

packageId.description: Numeric id of a hosting package assigned to the account.

tools.name: playsystemsapi_get_web_usage
tools.title: Get web usage
tools.description: Get web usage statistics for a hosting package: bandwidth, disk, databases and mail counts. Read-only: GET /cloud/package/{packageId}/web/usage.

packageId.description: Numeric id of a hosting package assigned to the account.

tools.name: playsystemsapi_get_domain
tools.title: Get domain
tools.description: Get one domain on a hosting package: name, expiry and status. Read-only: GET /cloud/package/{packageId}/domain/{domainId}.

packageId.description: Numeric id of a hosting package assigned to the account.

domainId.description: Domain id, as returned by the domain tools.

tools.name: playsystemsapi_get_domain_dns
tools.title: Get domain DNS records
tools.description: Get the DNS records of one domain on a hosting package, with suggested nameservers. Read-only: GET /cloud/package/{packageId}/domain/{domainId}/dns.

packageId.description: Numeric id of a hosting package assigned to the account.

domainId.description: Domain id, as returned by the domain tools.

tools.name: playsystemsapi_search_domains
tools.title: Search domain availability
tools.description: Check whether a domain name or prefix is available, with its price and expiry. Read-only: GET /cloud/domain-search/{prefix_or_name}.

prefix_or_name.description: Domain name or prefix to look up, for example example or example.gr.
